evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting.
evaluations.rationale: This story specifies search via content identification/fingerprinting, a distinct context/approach compared to other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on my profile.
evaluations.rationale: Search based on the user's profile is a distinct context/requirement from other discovery approaches.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on other users similar to myself.
evaluations.rationale: This targets collaborative filtering / similar-user driven search, distinct from other search methods.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity.
evaluations.rationale: This is search-by-example (content-similarity) — a different context from other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags...
evaluations.rationale: Search using enriched metadata/image tags is a distinct method/context from other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps.
evaluations.rationale: This is an upload/tags persistence requirement, different in goal and context from discovery or analysis stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to view thumbnail sequences of video segments.
evaluations.rationale: UI requirement to view thumbnail sequences is distinct from other content-analysis or search stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: This requirement is essentially the same as ZO-009 (both request info about similar video items/segments); no meaningful actor/context/goal difference.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about perceptually similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained in/overlaps with ZO-008 (both request info about similar video items/segments); the qualifier 'perceptually' does not change actor, context, or goal sufficiently.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations from similar profiles.
evaluations.rationale: This is a recommendation use-case (receive recommendations), distinct in goal from similar-user search stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area.
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation driven by local news events is a distinct context and business rule.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Person identification plus enrichment is a distinct detection/enrichment requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify products in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is a different target/entity type than other identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo detection is a specific target distinct from other detection stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification targets a different class of entities; not a duplicate of other identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image.
evaluations.rationale: Search-by-image / image-to-video recommendation is a distinct interaction and context.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area...
evaluations.rationale: Geographical map-based discovery is a distinct context and goal.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search content items using automatic speech recognition.
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct search modality and context.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see, validate and edit segmentation of videos.
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing is a distinct administrative task.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment.
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction for news segments is a specific admin requirement distinct from other segmentation tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects.
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by A/V quality is a distinct quality-assessment use-case.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload.
evaluations.rationale: Audio-edit detection is a specific analysis distinct from other quality or content filters.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter nudity content.
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering nudity is a specific moderation rule distinct from other prefilter types.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information.
evaluations.rationale: Prefilter via low-level asset features is a different technical approach than high-level prefilters.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement.
evaluations.rationale: Automatic copyright validation is a distinct compliance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags...
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag-based prefilter is a different context from low-level or specific-content prefilters.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk.
evaluations.rationale: Assessing interest/appeal/complexity is a distinct analytics requirement for administration.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting when to notify/prompt a scientist is a specific workflow trigger different from other detection stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify volunteer types.
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-typing is a distinct profiling classification task not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification (Galaxy Zoo) using low-level features is distinct from other project preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them.
evaluations.rationale: Project- and goal-specific detection (no classifiable animals) is distinct from other detection requirements.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting image series/timestamp malfunction is a unique technical need for that project.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific species preclassification differs in context from other preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is a different target/goal than species or number detection.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a distinct requirement from species/attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal.
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization for plankton is a specific image-analysis task for that project.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific detection of unclassifiable images is distinct from other no-classifiable detection stories by project context.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is a different measurement task from segmentation or species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for Plankton Portal is project-specific and distinct from other preclassification entries.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab.
evaluations.rationale: Motion-analysis to reduce video duration is a specific processing goal for that project.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg.
evaluations.rationale: Event-detection (egg-laying time) is a distinct analytic requirement from general motion-analysis.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images.
evaluations.rationale: Disaster-feature detection in satellite imagery is distinct from other image-analysis tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience.
evaluations.rationale: Assessing volunteer classification weight based on experience is a distinct voting/weighting business rule.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors.
evaluations.rationale: Artifact-removal prefilter is a specific technical prefiltering requirement distinct from general low-/high-level filters.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect moving and transient objects in the images.
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a distinct analytic task.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files.
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a distinct processing requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group whale calls that are similar.
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping whale calls is a specific audio-analysis requirement distinct from counting or denoising.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file.
evaluations.rationale: Counting distinct whales in audio is a different analytic goal from grouping similar calls.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should interrupt a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Determining when to interrupt is a specific interaction-timing requirement distinct from education triggers.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: Selecting interruption modality is a distinct decision tied to interruption actions; different goal than education modality.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should educate a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Timing for education is a different workflow than interruption; distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education modality is distinct from interruption modality and from knowing when to educate.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin,I want to know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Choosing specific educational content is a distinct decision separate from modality or timing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is a different trigger/analytic requirement than prompting scientists or Zoonibot actions.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Determining when an automated bot should comment is a distinct automation trigger, different from detecting volunteer comments.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should give an explanation.
evaluations.rationale: Triggering bot explanations is a different decision point than knowing when it should comment or what it should say.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Content-generation for Zoonibot responses is a distinct requirement from deciding when or whether the bot should act.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group subjects by similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Grouping subjects by similarity is a generic clustering requirement distinct from project-specific grouping tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences.
evaluations.rationale: Project-recommendation based on volunteer history is a distinct recommendation/business-rule task.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them.
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is a unique content-processing requirement not duplicated elsewhere.
